text:
mira: Heads up — RC cutover in ~45m. Need 2x LGTM for PR #7890 (kv-cache-regression-fix). Sam is offline (PST), Kai is on-call (APAC). Can folks stagger approvals so we don't miss the window? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7890

kai: I'm online, running a quick staging smoke now. Will ping with results in ~5m.

kai: Smoke looks good — one unrelated flaky test. I can give the first LGTM after that sanity check.

jen: I can provide the second LGTM in ~20m. Any special merge instructions or rollback plan?

mira: Merge with `gh pr merge 7890 --squash --delete-branch` and tag `release/rc`. If anything goes sideways we already have `revert-7890` branch prepped as a fallback.

oliver: tiny nit in a comment but non-blocking. :thumbsup:

sam: (just woke up, PST) Sorry for the late ping — giving LGTM now. Good catch on the test fixes.

mira: Awesome, thanks Sam. Kai — can you schedule the merge at 15:20 UTC so warmups finish? We want the KV-cache warmup to complete before traffic ramps.

kai: Will trigger merge at 15:20 UTC. I'll also kick off the warmup script and watch preflight logs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Merge scheduled by @kai for PR #7890 at 15:20 UTC. Running preflight checks and kv-cache warmup. Preflight link: https://ci.redwood.ai/preflight/7890

jen: I'll monitor post-merge smoke and keep the rollback window open for 30m. If we see >1% p99 latency regression I'll revert.

mira: Perfect — thanks everyone. If merge succeeds, I'll follow up with a short post-cutover note in #eng-status. :rocket:
